coverage.label: Type coverage
coverage.heading: Weaknesses and coverage
coverage.seTitle: Members with a super-effective attack on it
coverage.nothingNeutral: Nothing on the team hits this type for neutral damage
coverage.help: Columns are your Pokémon (the damage they take from each type). “Hit SE” counts members with a super-effective attack; ✕ means nothing hits that type even neutrally.

threats.label: Threats
threats.heading: Threats in {format}
threats.noUsage: No usage statistics for this format, so no threat list.
threats.none: Something on your team answers each of the {n} most used Pokémon.
threats.help: Checks the {n} most used Pokémon on their most common item, spread and moves ({source}{stats, select, none {} other {, {battles, number} battles, downloaded {fetched}}}). A member answers a threat if it survives every roll of its strongest attack from full HP, or outspeeds it and OHKOs it at least half the time. No Tera, no boosts, no hazards.

matchup.shrugs: takes nothing it can't shrug off
matchup.noHurt: has no attack that hurts it
